_doc: Single source of truth for per-crate line-coverage thresholds. Read by `_coverage_check` inside `make test`. Thresholds are monotonically increasing — only ratchet UP, never down. `make test` (and therefore CI) fails if ANY listed crate drops below its threshold. A `<crate>::<module>` key gates one module (`src/<module>.rs` + `src/<module>/`); each module absorbed by [CRATE-LAYOUT-MODULES] keeps its old crate's floor.
